title: Payment Processing Standard — Returned Installment Payments on Home Purchase Financing Loans
content:
**Operating standard: returned installment payments (Home Purchase Financing)**

1. **Reversal.** A returned installment payment is reversed bucket by bucket against that payment — its principal portion restored to principal and its escrow portion reversed out of escrow — and the next due date moves back to the installment it had satisfied.
2. **Once only.** A payment is reversed only once. Whether it already has been is read from the loan's transaction record of returns pointing to that same payment.
3. **Fee — retired clause.** *"The returned-payment fee of the program's returned-payment fee figure is charged when the return reason is insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment or invalid account, never for bank processing error." This clause is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as a record.*
4. **Second returned autopay draft.** When a second autopay draft is returned within 12 months, autopay is cancelled and later installments must be paid through another accepted channel. The returned autopay drafts counted are the returns of payments that arrived by ACH autopay in the trailing 12 calendar months ending on and including the date of the newest return.

### Illustration (hypothetical installment)

| Portion of the returned installment | Effect of the reversal |
|---|---|
| Principal 60.00 | 60.00 restored to the unpaid principal |
| Escrow 80.00 | 80.00 reversed out of escrow |
| Due date satisfied, 2026-04-01 | the next due date moves back to 2026-04-01 |

*Autopay count (hypothetical dates).* An autopay draft returned on 2026-06-10, after an earlier autopay draft returned on 2025-09-03, is the second within the trailing 12 calendar months, so autopay is cancelled. Had the earlier return been dated 2025-06-01, it would fall outside that window and the June return would be the first.

superseded_clauses: The returned-payment fee of nsf_fee is charged when the return reason is insufficient_funds, account_closed, stop_payment or invalid_account, never for bank_processing_error.
